description: Step-by-step: where the "Download IFC (BIM)" and "Download FBX (3ds Max)" buttons are (step "3D composition scheme" → "Documents" drawer), what the IFC4 and FBX files contain and what they do not (no textures/UV, BIM properties only in IFC4, ceiling fixing points as IfcDiscreteAccessory objects), and when the 1:1 ceiling drawing opens (only after the production brief is started in production). With a code, the answer starts with the status of that composition (full calculation / calculated individually; ribbon, chain, frame, ready scene). Text in English or Russian.
